answer: Admission should be a scarce, delayed auction rather than a free name. A new agent parks already-earned POA in a one-way queue whose release date cannot be sped up; that parked claim is a walnut the attacker must fund and wait out for every alias. Mid-queue, a falcon of independent miners cross-checks arrival jitter and funding graphs. Any pair that shares saffron traces or the same payment path is evicted and the parked POA is burned, so influence arrives only after per-identity capital and calendar time that a swarm cannot cheaply replicate.
